search_console.decision: The September 7–October 4 report showed 1,214 impressions, two clicks, 0.2% CTR, and average position 35.3. Stem Cell CBG had the only supported position 4–20 page signal, with 13 impressions, one click, and position 5.3, and it was materially expanded on October 8. Remaining position 4–20 page and query rows had only one to seven impressions, so no Data-led item was justified; those tiny samples and the single Oklahoma-law query click were deliberately ignored. Today's new pages diversify into a minor-cannabinoid product audit, a dated federal-jurisdiction digest, and a responsible social-hosting system while strengthening crawl paths.
